description: Demonstrates the openeval.judge_hardening convention from Discussion #11: a runner executing an llm_judge grader self-reports which prompt-injection mitigations it actually applied (e.g. structured output, delimited untrusted content, output-length caps), rather than the spec asserting mitigations were applied. This needs no schema change -- GraderResult.metadata already allows arbitrary keys -- but a conformance implementation must accept it without complaint, and the value itself is a free-text convention (a '+'-joined set of mitigation names), not schema-enforced, since standardizing prompt-assembly itself is explicitly out of scope (see Discussion #11).

results.actual_output: Paris is the capital of France.
